limitations: No new hands-on test was completed.
Public feedback is smaller than it is for larger screen-recording tools.

claims.statement: The Tella 2.0 Product Hunt listing is dated July 29, 2020.
Tella offers browser, desktop, and extension recording options with editing and sharing features.
Users often value quick clip-based recording and visual polish.
Users also report a learning curve, occasional recording failures, and limits for detailed production work.

scoreRationale.onboarding: Tella is quick to start, but its visual editor and layout choices take more time than a basic recorder.
scoreRationale.product: Clip recording and editing make it strong for polished short videos, but it is not the deepest production editor.
scoreRationale.support: The public sample is small and includes reports of recording failures, so confidence here is limited.
scoreRationale.billing: The free tier is useful for trying the workflow. Paid plans add features that matter for frequent business use.
scoreRationale.overall: Tella makes short, polished screen videos easier, but people who only need a simple recorder or heavy editing may want a different tool.

conflictsAndUnknowns: No new hands-on test was completed.
Reported recording problems may depend on browser, device, or workflow.
